name: MIC (Lipo-C with B12)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: MIC (Lipo-C with B12) is a ready-to-use liquid blend supplied as both lyophilized powder and sterile solution formats. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 10 mg, 10 ml. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Component ratios follow the specification printed on each vial label. Purity is stated at ≥99% (HPLC); appearance differs by format (powder vs solution). For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: What documentation is supplied with MIC (Lipo-C with B12)?
faq.answer: Every batch of MIC (Lipo-C with B12) is released against a lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA) that records the product identity, grade, appearance and the batch number. The COA for the lot you receive is available on request.

faq.question: How should MIC (Lipo-C with B12) be stored?
faq.answer: This item ships in more than one format: keep lyophilized vials at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture, and keep solution vials at 2-8 °C without freezing. Follow the instructions printed on the certificate of analysis for each lot. This product is for laboratory research use only.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for MIC (Lipo-C with B12)?
faq.answer: MIC (Lipo-C with B12) is available in 2 configurations: 10 mg, 10 ml. Each kit contains 10 vials. Minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Volume pricing applies to 10-49 kits and 50+ kits.
